Internal Email
Sender: Network Operations Center
Subject: Explanation of alarms at multiple sites after parameter delivery for batch {batch}
Dear all:
Batch {batch} was originally scheduled for delivery at 02:00 UTC. Due to a 3-hour time zone conversion deviation in cross-regional coordination, it was actually executed ahead of schedule at local time {time}. Within 11 minutes after delivery, 24 sites across 3 cities successively reported "Cell out of service" and "S1 interface abnormal", involving a total of 61 base stations and 9 dedicated line users. The rollback script finished execution at {time}, and by {time} all alarms were cleared and services returned to normal. Verification confirmed that this batch modified 7 parameter templates in total, 2 of which conflicted with neighbor cell handover thresholds, and no gray-scale verification was performed according to the process before delivery.
Additionally: the weak indoor signal issue reported by an administrative duty officer of a hospital was verified to be a fault in the hospital's self-built indoor distribution system, and a separate {ticket} has been created for tracking.
This impact has constituted a regional-level event, and the on-duty engineer has been called and the on-duty manager reported to according to the process.
